versions.changelog: Standardize the quick scan, agent workflow, and discovery appendix. Put English before Chinese; preserve installation and execution steps. / 统一速览、Agent流程和搜索附录，英文在前中文在后，保留安装与执行步骤。

Initial release of raspberry-pi-health-check.

- Assess Raspberry Pi health issues: slow performance, overheating, instability, disk space, or service problems.
- Performs read-only checks on CPU load, memory, swap, storage, temperature, undervoltage, throttling, and failed services.
- Integrates with JishuBuddy for secure SSH-based device evidence collection (with explicit user approval).
- Provides guidance on interpreting results and prohibits automatic or unsafe remediations.
- Supports manual evidence collection if agent installation is declined or unsupported.
- Clear user consent process for any tool installation; no actions without approval.
